purpose: Candidate-discovery index only. This file must not be interpreted as a final roster or as authority for Player ID issuance.

methodology.promotion_rule: A player may be promoted to a final roster only after contemporary or official roster/participation evidence independently confirms tournament participation.
methodology.player_id_rule: Do not create or link a Player ID from Volleybox identity fields alone. Official exact name+DOB identity is required; existing canonical IDs must be reused.
methodology.gender_filter: Require men's tournament classification/result to match the target event. Women Volleybox hostnames can contain male profiles, but tournament result/gender must be independently checked to prevent women's U21 entries from being mixed into the men's roster.
methodology.age_team_mapping_note: Historical Asian U20 events are indexed by Volleybox under the South Korea U21 team page; do not assume the modern team-page label equals the historical competition age label.
methodology.identity_conflict_rule: When Volleybox identity fields conflict with an official KVL identity source, preserve the conflict as a warning and never overwrite the canonical KVL identity.
